description: PostgreSQL helper library for Python (connection pooling, session management, query building, CRUD, batch, stored funcs)

guidelines_and_rules.no_pokemon_exceptions: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Never catch broad exceptions ('except Exception:', 'except (psycopg.Error, Exception):', catch-them-all). Always catch explicit, narrow exception types (e.g. psycopg.Error, queue.Empty, queue.Full).
guidelines_and_rules.delete_safety: delete() without where kwargs requires allow_all=True.

caddix.__init__.py: Exports: Setup (Configs), PGPool, DatabaseSession, CaddixError, CaddixSessionError, dict_row, tuple_row, scalar_row, class_row, namedtuple_row
caddix.config.py: Configs / Setup: Thread-safe singleton registry for PG connection parameters (dbname, user, host, port, max_conns, options)
caddix.pool.py: PGPool: Connection pool wrapper around psycopg_pool.ConnectionPool; handles checkouts, returns, connection health
caddix.base.py: DatabaseSession: Core DB interface. Methods: query, select, select_one, select_many, insert, insert_batch, update, update_batch, upsert, upsert_batch, delete, exists, call_func, call_proc. Exceptions: CaddixError, CaddixSessionError
caddix.stores.py: KeyValueStore / Store: Abstraction for simple key-value / document persistence on PostgreSQL tables
caddix.utils.py: Query building helpers: identifier quoting, parameter sanitization, batch query construction
